van Geene, L. (2025). Update report: Decarbonisation options for salt and chlor-alkali production by Nobian Industrial Chemicals B.V. MIDDEN report update, PBL publication number 5825. The Hague: PBL Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency and TNO Energy Transition. Date of update 25 September 2025. www.pbl.nl/en

15-page MIDDEN update on Nobian's tailor-made agreement options; not covered by MIDDEN database v0.4a. Loaded: MVR brine vaporisation (Fig. 3.2 heat and electricity per t undried salt, project capex EUR 499 million with 2 x 26 MW capacity, SDE++ EUR 1346/kWth), forced-circulation and zero-gap chlor-alkali electrolysis electricity (Table 3.1), zero-gap retrofit capex EUR 230 million with 640 kt/yr Cl2 capacity, brine recovery unit capex EUR 27 million. Not loaded (in _other-values): salt extraction statistics (Table 2.1), production capacities and 2023 production (Table 2.2), site energy demand 2023/2030 (Table 3.3), discharge reductions (Table 3.2), subsidies, e-flex capacities, the report's derived EUR 120 million per location, emissions. Figures 2.1-2.2 (ETS emissions) not transcribed. No O&M, TRL or lifetime printed.

(1) No currency year for any cost; taken as 2024 (tailor-made agreement, Rijksoverheid 2024) and 2025 for the SDE++ unit cost. (2) Cost basis not stated; the EUR 499 million MVR estimate is about twice the SDE++-based EUR 240 million, attributed to unspecified overhauls. (3) MVR capacity '26 MW per location' does not say electric or thermal; EUR 120 million at EUR 1346/kWth implies about 89 MWth per location, so 26 MW is read as electric. (4) Fig. 3.2 prints cooled water as '3.1 t' against 4.3 kt brine and 1.025 kt salt (likely kt). (5) Colophon citation says 'van Geene, L. (2024)' while the update is dated 25 September 2025. (6) Delfzijl chlorine capacity printed as 120 kt/yr (Table 2.2) and 'around 100 kilotonne' (p.11). (7) Table 3.1 electricity values are derived by the author from a Euro Chlor sector average and an assumed 15% saving, not plant data; the Table 2.2 hydrogen value uses a decimal comma ('2,8'). (8) Heating-value basis not stated.
